SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S. B. REGISTRY.
64 /
Date June 26, 19 35

Subject Soviet newspaper "IZVESTIA."

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by [Signature]

Further to the report dated January 14, 1935, on the subject
of the Soviet newspaper "IZVESTIA," I have to state that a regular
perusal of this newspaper during three months' period of subscript-
ion (January-March, 1935) shows that it contains no information of
interest from the local police viewpoint.

Members of the Political Section of the French police where
"PRAVDA" - another Moscow newspaper of importance - is available,
are of the opinion that the latter newspaper presents more interest
than "IZVESTIA" only because it publishes from time to time articles
by A. Gartman, "Pravda's" correspondent in Shanghai. These
articles, however, are described as summaries of information
published in the local foreign and Chinese press on questions
relating to the general political situation in the Far East.

I, therefore, beg respectfully to suggest that the subscript-
ion to "IZVESTIA" be discontinued.

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

（批：I agree with DSI Prokofiev）
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).
S2.

（批：81.9. Prok 26/6/35）

（批：I think China Today, an
American publication would contain more
information useful from our point of view than
either of the publications mentioned above. JLS
28 JUNE 1935）

x M.J.D. 6521

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第二股
报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号：S. B. REGISTRY.
64 /
日期：1935年6月26日

事由：苏联报纸《消息报》（IZVESTIA）。

呈报人：侦探长普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev） 转呈人：[签名]

继1935年1月14日关于苏联报纸《消息报》（IZVESTIA）的报告之后，本人谨陈述，在三个月的订阅期（1935年1月至3月）内定期阅览该报显示，从本地警务角度来看，该报不包含任何令人感兴趣的信息。

法租界警务处政治股的同仁可以获取另一份重要的莫斯科报纸《真理报》（PRAVDA），他们认为后者比《消息报》更具参考价值，这仅仅是因为该报不时刊登A. Gartman的文章，Gartman是《真理报》驻上海记者。然而，这些文章被描述为对本地外文及中文报刊上发表的、涉及远东总体政治局势问题的信息的摘要。

因此，本人谨建议停止订阅《消息报》。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
侦探长

（批注：我同意侦探长普罗科菲耶夫的意见）
副总监（特务科）。
S2.

（批注：81.9. Prok 1935年6月26日）

（批注：我认为《今日中国》（China Today），一份美国出版物，会比上述两份刊物包含更多从我们角度看来有用的信息。JLS 1935年6月28日）

x M.J.D. 6521

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. R.CISTM.
Section B, Special Br. Station,
REPORT
Date. January 14, 1935.

Subject. Soviet newspaper "IZVESTIA".

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by JBRm S/.

With reference to the endorsement of the Deputy
Commissioner (Special Branch) on the attached cutting from
the "New World" of January 7, 1935, on the subject of the
Soviet newspaper "IZVESTIA", a copy of the newspaper in
question was obtained by the undersigned from the American
Book & Supply Co. for perusal. It contains no informat-
ion bearing on the local situation or otherwise of interest
to this Section.

The Political Section of the French Police subscribe
to another Moscow newspaper entitled "PRAVDA", which they
find of more interest from the local police viewpoint than
"IZVESTIA".

I beg respectfully to suggest a subscription to
"IZVESTIA" for three months, during which period an opinion
can be formed as to the advisability of a further subscript-
ion. Copies of "PRAVDA" may be obtained from the French
Police for same purpose and for comparison with "IZVESTIA."

A. Prokofiev
D. S. I.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch)

（批：Approved [签名]）

（批：J.B.R. 14/1）
（批：D.S.I. Prokofiev. [签名]）

Sir,
Subscription to "IZVESTIA" for the first quarter
of 1935 has been arranged. A. Prokofiev

（批：$5, Please note. JMS JAN. 22 1935）
（批：Who 23/1/35.）
（批：JBR 22/1）
D.S.I. 22-1-35

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号：R.CISTM.
特务科B股分站，
报告
日期：1935年1月14日。

事由：苏联报纸《消息报》（IZVESTIA）。

呈报人：侦探长普罗科菲耶夫 转呈人：JBRm S/.

鉴于副总监（特务科）在附件中1935年1月7日《新世界》（New World）剪报上关于苏联报纸《消息报》（IZVESTIA）一事的批示，具名人已从美华书馆供应公司（American Book & Supply Co.）获取该报一份以供阅览。该报不包含涉及本地局势或本股感兴趣的其他信息。

法租界警务处政治股订阅了另一份名为《真理报》（PRAVDA）的莫斯科报纸，他们发现从本地警务角度来看，该报比《消息报》更具参考价值。

本人谨建议订阅《消息报》三个月，在此期间可对是否继续订阅形成意见。《真理报》的副本可向法租界警务处获取，用于相同目的并与《消息报》进行比较。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
侦探长

副总监（特务科）

（批注：批准 [签名]）

（批注：J.B.R. 1月14日）
（批注：侦探长普罗科菲耶夫。[签名]）

先生，
1935年第一季度的《消息报》订阅事宜已安排妥当。 A. 普罗科菲耶夫

（批注：5美元，请知悉。JMS 1935年1月22日）
（批注：Who 1935年1月23日。）
（批注：JBR 1月22日）
侦探长 1935年1月22日

THE NEW WORLD, MONDAY, JANUARY, 7, 1935

READ
in 1935
the great Soviet daily
the central organ of the Government of the USSR
“IZVESTIA TSIK SSSR I VTSIK”
(NEWS OF THE CENTRAL EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE USSR AND THE
ALL-RUSSIAN CENTRAL EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE)

“IZVESTIA” gives complete informative and leading material on all questions of politics,
economics and cultural construction of the Soviet Union as well as of foreign
countries.
This paper pays special attention to international political questions.

“IZVESTIA” full illuminates questions of the theatre, musics, cinema, paintings, architecture,
science and technique, sport, criticism and biography.
Each number of “IZVESTIA” is richly illuminated.

“IZVESTIA” has its own correspondents in all large cities of Europe, Asia and America.

SUBSCRIPTION PRICE:
1 Year ...... Am. Doll. 10.00    6 Months ...... Am. Doll. 5.50

Orders to be placed with:
THE AMERICAN BOOK & SUPPLY CO.
410, Szechuen Road, P. O. Box 1798.    SHANGHAI

D.C. ( Special Branch )
Information

SMB 9/1.    S2. Please endeavour
to obtain one copy and see
if it would be any use to
us.
JLS
JAN - 9 1935

DSI. Prokofiev.
SMB 9/1.

《消息报》提供有关苏联及外国政治、经济和文化建设所有问题的完整资讯和主要材料。
本报特别关注国际政治问题。

《消息报》充分阐释戏剧、音乐、电影、绘画、建筑、科学与技术、体育、评论和传记等领域的问题。
每期《消息报》均配有丰富的插图。

《消息报》在欧洲、亚洲和美洲的所有大城市均设有自己的通讯员。
